title: fix: skip inject_event when inject flow type is wrong

proposed.title: Reject incompatible flows before constructing injection events

saved.title: Reject incompatible flows before constructing injection events
saved.body:
Symptom: Injecting messages into an incompatible flow or passing a bare @focus string can crash with AttributeError instead of only logging a warning.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/proxyserver.py:Proxyserver.inject_websocket, Proxyserver.inject_tcp, and Proxyserver.inject_udp logged failed flow checks but continued constructing events and calling inject_event, which accesses flow.client_conn.
Fix pattern: Return immediately after the incompatible-flow warning, before constructing messages or injection events.
Constraints: WebSocket injection requires an HTTPFlow with websocket present; TCP and UDP injection require their respective flow types. Passing these checks does not establish a live connection: correctly typed flows must still reach the existing live-connection check.

title: Fix a flow reader bug found with fuzzing

proposed.title: Validate decoded flow records before migration

saved.title: Validate decoded flow records before migration
saved.body:
Symptom: Reading malformed saved flow data can fail without the expected FlowReadException.
Root cause: mitmproxy/io/io.py:FlowReader passed decoded non-dictionary values into flow migration without checking their shape.
Fix pattern: Reject non-dictionary records with ValueError before migration, inside the handler that converts ValueError into FlowReadException.
Constraints: This check validates the decoded record's outer type; dictionary records must still pass through migration and Flow.from_state.

proposed.title: Measure HAR request body size without decoding content

saved.title: Measure HAR request body size without decoding content
saved.body:
Symptom: HAR export crashes for malformed flows with invalid Content-Encoding headers.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/savehar.py:SaveHar calculated request bodySize from request.content, whose decoding can raise ValueError.
Fix pattern: Calculate request bodySize from len(request.raw_content), using 0 when raw_content is absent or empty; this measures the encoded body without decoding it.
Constraints: This pattern applies to HAR request bodySize, not fields requiring decoded content. test/mitmproxy/addons/test_savehar.py:test_content_raises verifies export succeeds even when accessing request.content and response.content raises ValueError.

proposed.title: URL assembly preserves text versus bytes
Normalize asterisk request targets at the request layer

saved.title: URL assembly preserves text versus bytes
saved.body:
Symptom: Reconstructing a URL from byte components produces text containing Python byte-literal representations.
Root cause: mitmproxy/net/http/url.py:unparse used string interpolation for byte components as well as text components.
Fix pattern: Select text or byte formatting according to the scheme type, preserving the component representation in the returned URL.
Constraints: Use consistently text or byte components; the overloads cover text scheme/host returning str and byte scheme/host returning bytes, not arbitrary mixed representations.

saved.title: Normalize asterisk request targets at the request layer
saved.body:
Invariant: When constructing an absolute request URL, a request path of '*' is represented as an empty URL path.
Enforcement: mitmproxy/http.py:Request.url and mitmproxy/http.py:Request.pretty_url each normalize the path before calling mitmproxy/net/http/url.py:unparse.
Layering: unparse appends the supplied path; request-target normalization belongs in the Request accessors.
Consequence: Skipping normalization in either accessor exposes a trailing '*' in that URL representation.
Constraints: This applies to absolute URL construction; Request.url's authority-format branch returns host:port directly.

title: Fix error while changing string-based options

proposed.title: Read grid editor text through the underlying widget

saved.title: Read grid editor text through the underlying widget
saved.body:
Symptom: Changing string-based console options such as mode or dns_name_servers raises AttributeError: 'AttrMap' object has no attribute 'get_text'.
Root cause: mitmproxy/tools/console/grideditor/col_bytes.py:Edit.get_data called get_text on self._w, which can be an AttrMap wrapper.
Fix pattern: Read text through self._w.base_widget.get_text(), then retain the existing stripping and escaped-string-to-bytes conversion.
Constraints: This pattern applies to text retrieval from the wrapped editor in Edit.get_data; it does not change byte conversion or invalid-input handling.

title: Do not block local mode connections

saved.title: Local mode bypasses peer-address blocking
saved.body:
Symptom: Local mode connections are blocked by the block addon even though local interception should be allowed.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/block.py:Block.client_connected classified the peer address without exempting local mode; on macOS, that address may be the interface's public IP.
Fix pattern: Return early for clients whose proxy_mode is mode_specs.LocalMode, before applying private or public address blocking.
Constraints: This exemption applies to local mode regardless of peer-address classification; preserve the existing loopback exemption and address-blocking behavior for other proxy modes.

title: Fix decompressing fake pointers in DNS messages

proposed.title: Tolerate fake compression pointers in DNS record data

saved.title: Tolerate fake compression pointers in DNS record data
saved.body:
Symptom: A DNS message fails to decode when ordinary record data resembles a domain-name compression pointer, including numeric data in an SOA record.
Root cause: mitmproxy/net/dns/domain_names.py:decompress_from_record_data treats bytes with leading bits 0b11 as pointer candidates, even when they belong to another data type.
Fix pattern: Catch struct.error around candidate decoding and replacement; leave failed candidates unchanged and advance the scan by one byte, while continuing to expand successfully decoded names.
Constraints: This fallback applies to struct.error from candidate decompression; it does not guarantee that every fake pointer is detected or justify suppressing other exception types.

proposed.title: Encode Unicode certificate DNS names with IDNA

saved.title: Encode Unicode certificate DNS names with IDNA
saved.body:
Symptom: Proxying Unicode domains fails when constructing certificate DNS names.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/tlsconfig.py:_ip_or_dns_name passed Unicode hostnames directly to x509.DNSName.
Fix pattern: Encode DNS names with val.encode("idna").decode() before constructing x509.DNSName; Unicode SNI is then represented as an ASCII name in certificate alternative names.
Constraints: Perform DNS encoding only after IP parsing fails in _ip_or_dns_name; valid IP literals must remain x509.IPAddress values.

saved.title: Keep overflowing view options scrollable
saved.body:
Symptom: The view options menu overflows when its options exceed the available menu height.
Root cause: Dropdown styling lacked a height limit and vertical scrolling; see web/src/css/dropdown.less:max-height and the menu consumer web/src/js/components/contentviews/ViewSelector.tsx:ViewSelector.
Fix pattern: Bound the dropdown height and enable vertical scrolling; the established declarations are max-height: 250px and overflow-y: scroll.
Constraints: This pattern addresses vertical dropdown overflow; the content view selector also uses top-end placement, which should not be generalized to other dropdowns from this fix alone.

title: web: don't crash when opening options

proposed.title: Keep option help text out of the choices argument

saved.title: Keep option help text out of the choices argument
saved.body:
Symptom: mitmweb crashes when opening options.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/savehar.py:SaveHar.load passed a second help-text string as the choices argument when registering hardump.
Fix pattern: Combine all help prose into one help argument; mitmproxy/addonmanager.py:Loader.add_option asserts that choices is not a string.
Constraints: Applies to addon option registration; help prose belongs in the help argument, and any supplied choices must satisfy the non-string guard.

proposed.title: Resolve postponed annotations when inspecting command signatures

saved.title: Resolve postponed annotations when inspecting command signatures
saved.body:
Symptom: Commands from modules using `from __future__ import annotations` fail to execute.
Root cause: Signature inspection in mitmproxy/command.py:Command and mitmproxy/command.py:verify_arg_signature did not evaluate string annotations.
Fix pattern: Use `inspect.signature(..., eval_str=True)` when constructing command signatures and inspecting callables for argument verification.
Constraints: Applies to command signature inspection with postponed annotations; preserve the existing argument-binding validation via `sig.bind(*args, **kwargs)`.

proposed.title: Select HTTP mode from the outer proxy layer

saved.title: Select HTTP mode from the outer proxy layer
saved.body:
Invariant: Select HTTPMode.upstream when context.layers[0] is an instance of modes.HttpUpstreamProxy; otherwise select HTTPMode.regular.
Enforcement: mitmproxy/addons/next_layer.py:NextLayer checks the outermost context layer before constructing layers.HttpLayer.
Failure: Unconditionally selecting HTTPMode.regular gives upstream proxy stacks the wrong HTTP mode.
Constraints: Apply this check at the HTTP layer construction shown here, including after an optional ClientTLSLayer is added.

proposed.title: Snapshot transports before awaiting writer drains

saved.title: Snapshot transports before awaiting writer drains
saved.body:
Symptom: Draining proxy connection writes can fail when transports change during drainage.
Root cause: mitmproxy/proxy/server.py:ConnectionHandler.drain_writers iterated the live self.transports.values() view across await transport.writer.drain().
Fix pattern: Snapshot the transport values with list(self.transports.values()) before iterating across awaits.
Constraints: This addresses changes to collection membership during drainage; preserve the existing _drain_lock and writer-is-not-None guard.

title: remove overambitious assertion found with fuzzing, fix #5343

proposed.title: Ignore late HTTP events for streams no longer tracked

saved.title: Ignore late HTTP events for streams no longer tracked
saved.body:
Symptom: The HTTP proxy hits an assertion when data arrives for a stream it has already finished handling.
Root cause: mitmproxy/proxy/layers/http/__init__.py:HttpLayer assumed that events whose stream ID was absent from self.streams could only be RequestProtocolError or ResponseProtocolError.
Fix pattern: Ignore events whose stream ID is no longer tracked; late events may contain data as well as errors.
Constraints: Apply this tolerance to the missing-stream lookup branch; events for tracked streams must still be forwarded through event_to_child.

proposed.title: Windows transparent destination resolution must recover from an uninitialized connection

saved.title: Windows transparent destination resolution must recover from an uninitialized connection
saved.body:
Symptom: Windows transparent mode raises AttributeError while resolving the original destination before the upstream connection is established.
Root cause: mitmproxy/platform/windows.py:Resolver.original_addr writes to self.wfile before it has been initialized by Resolver._connect.
Fix pattern: Include AttributeError alongside EOFError and OSError in the connection-recovery handler, which calls Resolver._connect and retries Resolver.original_addr.
Constraints: This recovery applies to Windows transparent-mode original destination lookup; the missing-wfile case requires connection initialization before retrying.
